dashboard_slides_name_valid.name: dashboard_slides_name_valid
dashboard_slides_name_valid.value: "dashboard_slides"."name" is null or char_length("dashboard_slides"."name") between 1 and 60

dashboard_widgets_title_valid.name: dashboard_widgets_title_valid
dashboard_widgets_title_valid.value: "dashboard_widgets"."title" is null or char_length("dashboard_widgets"."title") between 1 and 100

dashboard_widgets_type_columns.name: dashboard_widgets_type_columns
dashboard_widgets_type_columns.value: case when "dashboard_widgets"."type" in ('metric', 'line', 'bar', 'table') then "dashboard_widgets"."connection_id" is not null and "dashboard_widgets"."metric_key" is not null and "dashboard_widgets"."aggregation" is not null and "dashboard_widgets"."period" is not null and "dashboard_widgets"."text" is null else "dashboard_widgets"."connection_id" is null and "dashboard_widgets"."metric_key" is null and "dashboard_widgets"."aggregation" is null and "dashboard_widgets"."period" is null and "dashboard_widgets"."display_currency" is null and "dashboard_widgets"."dimensions" = '{}'::jsonb and ("dashboard_widgets"."text" is not null) = ("dashboard_widgets"."type" = 'text') end

workspace_images_dimensions_valid.name: workspace_images_dimensions_valid
workspace_images_dimensions_valid.value: "workspace_images"."width" between 1 and 4096 and "workspace_images"."height" between 1 and 4096 and "workspace_images"."width"::bigint * "workspace_images"."height" <= 16777216

workspace_images_origin_valid.name: workspace_images_origin_valid
workspace_images_origin_valid.value: ("workspace_images"."origin" = 'upload' and "workspace_images"."connection_id" is null and "workspace_images"."resource_id" is null) or ("workspace_images"."origin" = 'resource_icon' and "workspace_images"."connection_id" is not null and "workspace_images"."resource_id" is not null)
